body.estimand_functional: \(\tau=\mathbb E\{h(W,1)-h(W,0)\}\) when a fortified outcome bridge exists and the actual-law proximal assumptions hold

sampling_model.design: An observational finite-proxy structural causal model with declared support \(S\) and factor-table parameter \(\theta\in\Theta_S\).
sampling_model.units: Independent draws from one compatible law \(P_\theta\); sampling inference is not part of the rank kernel.
sampling_model.overlap: Every cell in \(S\) and every latent state conditional on that cell has strictly positive probability; cells outside \(S\) are structural zeros.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nuisance estimator is assumed. The proposal characterizes algebraic feasibility of the fortified completeness premise, not estimation of \(h\).

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Fortified completeness identifies the average treatment effect when at least \(\gamma\) candidate treatment proxies are valid.
Two categorical proxies identify causal effects when the relevant observed conditional-probability matrix has sufficient rank.
A family has an independent transversal if and only if every subfamily satisfies the corresponding rank inequality.
Algebraic arguments establish generic identifiability for several finite latent product models outside exceptional varieties.
A combinatorial polynomial-time algorithm computes symbolic rank for generic partitioned matrices with \(2\times2\) coefficient blocks.
A minimax rank theorem applies to a restricted class of generic partitioned matrices.

body.tldr: Fortified proximal identification assumes an injective pairing between latent demand functions and a restricted supply of moments, but structural zeros make aggregate alphabet counts unreliable. The proposed Hall defect \(\eta(S)\), after removing the unavoidable block-constant loss \(\kappa_0(S)\), gives the exact generic rank \(Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\) on the compatible positive factor-table model. All quotient Hall inequalities are necessary and sufficient for generic full rank, their failure rules out this completeness route at every compatible law, and an exact submodular rank-oracle algorithm returns both the rank and a deficient-block certificate. Generic feasibility is kept distinct from completeness at the actual law and from identification of \(\tau\).

project_justification.gap: Finite proximal theory states categorical rank or completeness conditions at a law, while the fortified many-proxy theory supplies no support-pattern characterization. The banked rectangular result covers only equal alphabets and full support, where transitivity collapses all local obstructions to one dimension count.
project_justification.niche: A declared structural support creates a family of unequal treatment-by-complement blocks. After quotienting block constants, their latent contrasts form an independent-transversal problem, but the representatives must be realized simultaneously by positive stochastic factor tables.
project_justification.fill: The paper derives the support-incidence null quotient, proves the product-block Rado attainment and rational specialization, obtains the exact Hall frontier and law-uniform failure certificate, and supplies an exact submodular oracle algorithm.

body.related_work: Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen formulate fortified bridge moments and use fortified completeness for average-treatment-effect identification; their setup is the destination problem and not a theorem-level comparator. Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen provide the categorical matrix-rank foundation, without a structural-zero support theorem. Rado supplies the independent-transversal rank inequalities adapted after the block-null quotient. Iwata and Murota and Hirai and Iwamasa study generic partitioned matrices with independently generic scalar blocks, whereas the present matrices arise from positive row-stochastic product blocks and symbolic cell weights. Allman, Matias, and Rhodes supply the nonvanishing-minor logic and the distinction between generic and global identification. Wang and Kuo show why support-sensitive compatibility must be imposed before conditional tables represent a joint law. Schrijver supplies the exact submodular-minimization engine. Cui and coauthors and Zhang and coauthors clarify that completeness is a route premise and that bridge nonuniqueness need not imply failure of the causal functional.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The inherited claims about one nine-cell example and \(135\) binary cases were not used as evidence because the supplied discovery artifact did not specify the exact support encoding or provide a reproducible script. The proposal instead exposes the symbolic rank oracle and requires every computational exhibit to record \(S\), \(\alpha\), \(u\), \(D_S\), \(\kappa_0(S)\), and a maximizing Hall-deficient set.
body.honest_scope: The paper proves the generic-rank formula, Hall frontier, rational attainment, exact oracle, and the law-uniform rank classification. Even when the Hall frontier certifies generic feasibility, completeness must still hold at the actual law, a fortified bridge must exist, and the remaining proximal causal assumptions are required before \(\tau\) is identified. When the frontier fails, only this fortified outcome-pairing route is ruled out; another bridge route or target-invariance argument may remain valid. Under full rectangular support with common alphabet size, the result reduces to the banked arithmetic rank theorem.
